Core SQL reports and optional extensions

Unit 2 · Week 5 · Lesson 4 · Suggested 55-minute plan; adjust to local timing.

Prepare: Open a fresh working copy of database-project.sqlite in a school-approved SQLite tool. Keep sql-starter.sqlite unchanged. The project edition adds Equipment.ReplacementCost. Review database-project-setup.sql and use database-project-workbook.md, database-project-answers.md and database-project-reports.sql. Use fictional data and public explained answers. No cloud account is required. These 55-minute timings are flexible. Core checkpoint: Q2a two-table report and Q3 whole-inventory aggregates. Q2b four-table transfer and Q4 grouped category summaries are optional supporting extensions; use that time for another core attempt if needed. No additional lesson time or assessment requirement.

Suggested answers are teacher guidance, not extra assessment tasks. These notes are public.

1. Core SQL reports and optional extensions

Suggested time: 2 minutes

Instructional strategy: Learning intention and scope

Use database-project.sqlite, a fresh working copy of the project edition. Core: workbook Q2a and Q3; optional extension: Q2b and Q4. Extension success is not a core checkpoint or an added assessment requirement. Teach a retained extension before any locally issued assessment includes it. Year 11 inner joins and all five aggregates remain core; the syllabus sets no maximum join count. This lesson limits independent join depth for pacing. Source: https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0020/1232507/Computer-Science-ATAR-Year-11-Syllabus-for-teaching-from-2026.PDF printed p18. Start with the core. Slides 6–7 are optional after a successful independent attempt; otherwise use their 12 minutes for a changed core attempt and feedback.

2. Core: follow one taught key match

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Retrieval and key tracing

Use database-project.sqlite, a fresh working copy of the project edition. Core: workbook Q2a and Q3; optional extension: Q2b and Q4. Extension success is not a core checkpoint or an added assessment requirement. Teach a retained extension before any locally issued assessment includes it. Year 11 inner joins and all five aggregates remain core; the syllabus sets no maximum join count. This lesson limits independent join depth for pacing. Source: https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0020/1232507/Computer-Science-ATAR-Year-11-Syllabus-for-teaching-from-2026.PDF printed p18. Predict L001 E01 Camera; L006 E05 Microphone; L002 E02 Tripod; L004 E04 Camera. Use the two-table Loan/Equipment join. Four stored tables do not require four tables in every query. Earlier three-table models remain valid taught examples.

3. Core: summarise inventory rows

Suggested time: 8 minutes

Instructional strategy: Worked prediction

Use database-project.sqlite, a fresh working copy of the project edition. Core: workbook Q2a and Q3; optional extension: Q2b and Q4. Extension success is not a core checkpoint or an added assessment requirement. Teach a retained extension before any locally issued assessment includes it. Year 11 inner joins and all five aggregates remain core; the syllabus sets no maximum join count. This lesson limits independent join depth for pacing. Source: https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0020/1232507/Computer-Science-ATAR-Year-11-Syllabus-for-teaching-from-2026.PDF printed p18. There are five Equipment records. Execute against the project fixture: one row [5,1400,280.0,80,600]. Joining to loan history first repeats E02. COUNT(*) counts rows; the other functions summarise numeric values. No GROUP BY is needed for one whole-inventory result.

4. Core: check the complete summary

Suggested time: 8 minutes

Instructional strategy: Guided explanation

Use database-project.sqlite, a fresh working copy of the project edition. Core: workbook Q2a and Q3; optional extension: Q2b and Q4. Extension success is not a core checkpoint or an added assessment requirement. Teach a retained extension before any locally issued assessment includes it. Year 11 inner joins and all five aggregates remain core; the syllabus sets no maximum join count. This lesson limits independent join depth for pacing. Source: https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0020/1232507/Computer-Science-ATAR-Year-11-Syllabus-for-teaching-from-2026.PDF printed p18. Costs are 600,80,150,450,120. Count=5; sum=1400; mean=1400/5=280; minimum=80; maximum=600. For CategoryID C99 the filtered input is empty: COUNT is 0; SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX are NULL. Ask students to explain input row meaning, not simply copy totals.

5. Core: attempt, compare and retry

Suggested time: 15 minutes

Instructional strategy: Independent application and feedback

Use database-project.sqlite, a fresh working copy of the project edition. Core: workbook Q2a and Q3; optional extension: Q2b and Q4. Extension success is not a core checkpoint or an added assessment requirement. Teach a retained extension before any locally issued assessment includes it. Year 11 inner joins and all five aggregates remain core; the syllabus sets no maximum join count. This lesson limits independent join depth for pacing. Source: https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0020/1232507/Computer-Science-ATAR-Year-11-Syllabus-for-teaching-from-2026.PDF printed p18. Use the public answers only after the independent attempt. Q2a returns the four rows traced on slide 2. Q3 uses the summary on slides 3–4. A changed core retry filters Equipment to C01: count 2, sum 1050, mean 525, min 450, max 600. The core exit does not require either optional extension. This lesson is formative, not an assessment event.

6. Optional extension: group by category

Suggested time: 6 minutes

Instructional strategy: Optional worked transfer

Use database-project.sqlite, a fresh working copy of the project edition. Core: workbook Q2a and Q3; optional extension: Q2b and Q4. Extension success is not a core checkpoint or an added assessment requirement. Teach a retained extension before any locally issued assessment includes it. Year 11 inner joins and all five aggregates remain core; the syllabus sets no maximum join count. This lesson limits independent join depth for pacing. Source: https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0020/1232507/Computer-Science-ATAR-Year-11-Syllabus-for-teaching-from-2026.PDF printed p18. Q4 is optional supporting extension for this Year 11 lesson. Explain how GROUP BY forms one aggregate result per represented category. Every selected non-aggregate field is grouped. Inner join omits categories with no items. Expected C01 Imaging 2 1050; C02 Support 1 80; C03 Audio 2 270. Year 12 pathway Step 10 develops grouping. Do not treat this result as a compulsory core achievement.

7. Optional extension: check grouped totals

Suggested time: 6 minutes

Instructional strategy: Optional result comparison

Use database-project.sqlite, a fresh working copy of the project edition. Core: workbook Q2a and Q3; optional extension: Q2b and Q4. Extension success is not a core checkpoint or an added assessment requirement. Teach a retained extension before any locally issued assessment includes it. Year 11 inner joins and all five aggregates remain core; the syllabus sets no maximum join count. This lesson limits independent join depth for pacing. Source: https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0020/1232507/Computer-Science-ATAR-Year-11-Syllabus-for-teaching-from-2026.PDF printed p18. Q4 grouped counts sum to 5 and totals to 1400, matching the core inventory result. Optional Q2b adds borrower and category labels through a four-table join; full SQL and all four expected rows are in the explained answers. It extends independent join depth for this lesson, not a syllabus prohibition on four-table queries. Do not add it to core completion criteria or compulsory homework. If time is short, defer it; Year 12 pathway Step 09 provides four-table teaching.

8. Core exit: explain a fresh result

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Independent exit and planned retry

Use database-project.sqlite, a fresh working copy of the project edition. Core: workbook Q2a and Q3; optional extension: Q2b and Q4. Extension success is not a core checkpoint or an added assessment requirement. Teach a retained extension before any locally issued assessment includes it. Year 11 inner joins and all five aggregates remain core; the syllabus sets no maximum join count. This lesson limits independent join depth for pacing. Source: https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0020/1232507/Computer-Science-ATAR-Year-11-Syllabus-for-teaching-from-2026.PDF printed p18. Without notes: [2,25,12.5,10,15]. One equipment item may appear in several loan events, duplicating its cost if history rows are summed as inventory. If insecure, trace the two original equipment rows and retry using 8 and 12: [2,20,10,8,12]. Week 6 teaches creation, constraints and controlled changes; those are not this lesson’s objective.
